text: # Product Specification: OnMyDisk & OnMyChat This document outlines the technological stack, value proposition, and architecture of the OnMyDisk and OnMyChat ecosystem, highlighting how they integrate to provide a private, self-hosted cloud and AI experience. --- ## 1. Unified Value Proposition The core philosophy of the ecosystem is the **rejection of cloud abuse**. * **Privacy First**: No user data (files, chats, or memories) is stored on provider-managed cloud servers. All information remains on user-owned hardware. * **Local Inference**: Thinking (AI inference) happens on-device or on a private network node, preventing data leakage to external LLM providers. * **Direct Access**: Users access their data directly from their devices without mandatory synchronization or staging on intermediary servers. * **Empowered Metadata**: Personal documents and chat histories are converted into reusable, searchable knowledge via local vectorization. --- ## 2. Product Overview ### 2.1 OnMyDisk (OMD) - Self-Hosted Personal Cloud OnMyDisk is a distributed file-sharing platform that provides secure, remote access to files stored on physical devices (PCs, laptops, NAS, or WiFi routers). text: # Navodila za uporabo On My Disk Dobrodošli v **On My Disk** — vaši zasebni osebni platformi v oblaku. Za razliko od tradicionalnih storitev v oblaku On My Disk ohranja vaše datoteke in podatke na vaših napravah, kar zagotavlja popoln nadzor in zasebnost. --- ## 1. Prvi koraki (Onboarding) On My Disk lahko začnete uporabljati takoj, tako da izberete enega od dveh načinov dostopa. ### Anonimna prijava Če prvič odprete [onmydisk.net](https://onmydisk.net), vam bo sistem ponudil hitro nastavitev: 1. **Ime naprave**: Vnesite ime za vaš trenutni brskalnik (npr. "Moj prenosnik"). 2. **Pogoji**: Sprejmite pogoje uporabe (ToS) in politiko zasebnosti GDPR. 3. **Povezava mape**: Pozvani boste k izbiri lokalne mape za skupno rabo. Ta korak lahko preskočite in mape dodate pozneje. > [!NOTE] > Podatki anonimnega računa so shranjeni v vaši napravi. Ker On My Disk deluje neposredno z realnim datotečnim sistemom, brisanje predpomnilnika brskalnika ne bo povzročilo izgube vaših datotek. ### Prijava z Googlom Za zanesljiv dostop do vaših podatkov ter sinhronizacijo nastavitev in klepetov med napravami, izvedite prijavo z Googlom: 1. Kliknite na ikono profila v spodnjem levem kotu. 2. Izberite **Sign in with Google**. 3. Po avtorizaciji bodo vse vaše naprave, klepeti in nastavitve sinhronizirani. ### Ustvarjanje računa On

Data Flow ### 2.1 Request Handling (Common) 1. **Incoming Request**: `HttpServerBackend` receives an HTTP request. 2. **Auth & Routing**: `HttpServerBackend` determines the target `linkID` and `remotePath`. 3. **Handler Creation**: An `HttpHandler` is created to process the request. 4. **Resource Lookup**: `HttpHandler` looks up the `RemoteResource` corresponding to the path. ### 2.2 Data Flow: Legacy Client (LinkSocket) If the target is a legacy client: 1. **Backend Selection**: `RemoteResource` instantiates `LinkBackend` (default). 2. **Operation Call**: `LinkBackend` calls `OnMyDiskLink::invoke` (or specific method). 3. **Thread Selection**: `OnMyDiskLink` selects an available `LinkThread`. 4. **Transmission**: `LinkSocket` sends a binary `LinkMessage` over TCP/SSL. 5. **Execution**: Client executes the operation and sends a

text: `OnMyDiskLink::invoke` (or specific method). 3. **Thread Selection**: `OnMyDiskLink` selects an available `LinkThread`. 4. **Transmission**: `LinkSocket` sends a binary `LinkMessage` over TCP/SSL. 5. **Execution**: Client executes the operation and sends a `LinkMessage` response. 6. **Response**: `LinkSocket` receives the response, `LinkThread` passes it back to `LinkBackend`. ### 2.3 Data Flow: PWA Client (WebSocket) If the target is a PWA client: 1. **Backend Selection**: `RemoteResource` detects a `ClientNotifier` for the `linkID` and instantiates `WebSocketBackend`. 2. **Operation Call**: `WebSocketBackend` calls `ClientNotifier::fileApi(command)`. 3. **Signaling**: `ClientNotifier` emits `linkCommand` signal. 4. **Transmission**: `QWebChannel` (via `WebSocketTransport`) sends the command JSON to the browser via WebSocket. 5. **Execution**: Browser JS handles the command (File System Access API or simulated FS) and sends a response JSON. 6. **Response**: `ClientNotifier` receives `responseReady` signal with the JSON response and returns it to `WebSocketBackend`. ## 3. text: # Руководство пользователя On My Disk Добро пожаловать в **On My Disk** — вашу приватную персональную облачную платформу. В отличие от традиционных облачных сервисов, On My Disk оставляет ваши файлы и данные на ваших устройствах, обеспечивая полный контроль и конфиденциальность. --- ## 1. Начало работы (Onboarding) Вы можете начать пользоваться On My Disk мгновенно, выбрав один из двух способов доступа. ### Анонимный вход Если вы впервые открыли [onmydisk.net](https://onmydisk.net), система предложит вам быструю настройку: 1. **Имя устройства**: Введите имя для вашего текущего браузера (например, "My Laptop"). 2. **Соглашение**: Примите условия использования (ToS) и политику конфиденциальности (GDPR). 3. **Подключение папки**: Вам предложат выбрать локальную папку для общего доступа. Вы можете пропустить этот шаг и добавить папки позже. > [!NOTE] > Данные анонимного аккаунта сохраняются на вашем устройстве. Поскольку On My Disk работает напрямую с реальной файловой системой, очистка кеша браузера не приведет к потере ваших файлов. ### Вход через Google Для надежного доступа к вашим файлам на нескольких устройствах, синхронизации настроек и истории чатов выполните вход с помощью вашего Google аккаунта на всех ваших устройствах: 1. text: # Users Authorization[]{.mark} [This document defines users authorization of PeARS instance running as integrated search engine on On My Disk gateway node.]{.mark} []{.mark} []{.mark} []{.mark} []{.mark} []{.mark} [\ Figure 1: Process diagram of users authorization]{.mark} [\ ]{.mark}The purpose of authorization is preventing unauthorized users to access the potentially sensitive private data (text snippets, full URL paths, file names, etc) of the registered users of On My Disk gateway node. Search modes Depending on authorization level, there should be 2 modes implemented by PeARS: **Anonymous mode:** only shared links (URLs of publicly shared files and folders) matching the search request should be present in the search results. This mode is default for guests and non-signed in users. Indexed URLs may be filtered out by presence of key word "/shared" as the first section of URL path: /shared/\<pseudo_random_generated_link\>\ \ **User mode**: only URLs within the currently authorized user's devices should be returned in the search results. Indexed URLs may be filtered out by presence of the current user's name as the first section of URL path:[]{.mark} /\<user_name\>/\<device\>/path/to/File.txt\ \ Also shared links matching the search request should be included in the results for this mode. text: NGI Search Beneficiary Interview - Introduce yourself and your company, and explain what makes you > different. We are Alexey Volkov and Aurelie Herbelot. Aurelie is the instigator and lead developer of the PeARS project ([**https://pearsproject.org/**](https://pearsproject.org/)). PeARS is an open-source search engine that can be run locally inside a browser. It allows individuals to index and search Web pages, and to share their indexed data with others, bypassing centralized search engines. In the context of the NGI Search programme, On My Disk and PeARS have partnered to provide a decentralized search system over personal cloud data. The joint project will provide On My Disk users with a way to search documents seamlessly across networked devices. It will also be a foundational stone for an entirely new ecosystem combining private hosting and distributed Web search. The cooperation distinguishes itself from other solutions that require environmentally-damaging energy consumptions, such as blockchain-based systems. (1200 characters) While large enterprises leverage LLM-s and AI agents for personal assistance and business optimization, concerns about data protection, surveillance, and vendor lock-in become increasingly apparent. Do you know where your chat history is stored? Where your documents are uploaded? On My Chat, an AI extension to On My Disk, ensures full privacy for AI-assisted search and content generation. Your files remain on your device, processed by LLM of your choice—including larger models like Llama 2 or DeepSeek for complex tasks and smaller, efficient and genuine OSS models for lightweight local processing—running entirely offline. With On My Chat users get access to their On My Disk content through an natural language interface. They can instantly retrieve of key information (e.g., What is our VAT forecast?) and receive a response with supporting evidence from relevant documents (including sensitive, like invoices, bank statements, etc). During the NGI Zero Commons grant, we will develop a secure, containerized environment for running LLMs locally while enabling flexible remote access to AI assistants over the On My Disk network, ensuring complete data control. This prototype will feature: - Local knowledge: each assistant can be fine-tuned or trained completely from scratch for a specific domain of knowledge. The generated content is derived from the user's locally stored documents, retrieved through an integrated search engine. - Peer-to-Peer expertise sharing across AI assistants in the same organisation: When generating responses, assistants can collaborate by querying one another through the On My Disk access API (e.g. one member of organisation has already trained an agent on organisation’s financial data. My new assistant can send a query to that member’s assistant) On My Chat delivers AI access to privacy-first users—combining security, flexibility, and complete data ownership. To achieve the desired data flow and user experience, we will need to introduce our own OIDC provider in OMD gateway, implement app-specific proxy for Open WebUI, integrate local PeARS as a search provider for Open WebUI. For advanced hardware, a specialized OMD API layer should be developed to generate datasets from local files, enabling efficient local LLM training and fine-tuning. -OIDC Provider for OMD Implementing an OIDC provider in the On My Disk gateway will enable integration of Open WebUI application without modifications. It will provide a single sign-on (SSO) experience with the chat app, allowing users to log in to Open WebUI using their On My Disk account credentials. Additionally, implementing OIDC will enable other applications to authenticate users with On My Disk accounts. -Open WebUI API Communication Relay Implementing Open WebUI traffic relay over the On My Disk uplink protocol will allow users to communicate with their local AI assistants running on their home computers from any remote location.
